observe.photos-kept-as-evidence.en: Your photos were kept on this phone as evidence.
observe.photos-kept-as-evidence.ha: An ajiye hotunanka a wannan wayar a matsayin shaida.
observe.photos-kept-as-evidence.ig: Echekwara foto gị n'ekwentị a dị ka ihe akaebe.
observe.photos-kept-as-evidence.yo: A ti fi àwọn fọ́tò rẹ pamọ́ sórí fóònù yìí gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹ̀rí.

case.photo-kept-on-observer-phone.en: Photo kept on the observer's phone. The report is on the ledger.
case.photo-kept-on-observer-phone.ha: An ajiye hoton a wayar Mai Lura. Rahoton yana a littafin.
case.photo-kept-on-observer-phone.ig: Echekwara foto ahụ n'ekwentị Onye Na-ekiri Ihe. Akụkọ ahụ dị n'akwụkwọ ndekọ.
case.photo-kept-on-observer-phone.yo: A fi fọ́tò náà pamọ́ sórí fóònù Olùwòran. Ìròyìn náà wà lórí ìwé àkọsílẹ̀.

ledger.sheet-kept-on-phone.yo: a fi ìwé pamọ́ sórí fóònù
